extras.Scope: This run is the delta from GSL-250 run-02 (score 100, closed) to a fully-green Phase 7 feature-complete dossier. GSL-250 stays closed on its own run-02; this run adds the four items GSL-297 closed: the snapshot end-check (GSL-298), the AskUserQuestion answer-loop live proof (GSL-299), the PermissionRequest allow/deny live proof (GSL-300), and the Fleet live-values proof + underlying flushPendingObservations fix (GSL-301).
extras.Isolation: All live-proof runs used an isolated scratch tree under `.artifacts/gsl297-live/`: scratch DB, scratch lab dir, scratch bearer + internal secret, dedicated port 7332. Zero touch on the production `data/gosleep.db` or the shared `docs/lab/`. The launchd-managed prod core was not restarted.
extras.Live gates: core-smoke: 96 PASS / 0 FAIL (was 90 before GSL-298's +5 and GSL-301's +1). bun test (apps/core): 191 PASS / 0 FAIL (unchanged). tsc apps/core clean. tsc apps/web clean. vite build 2.74 s. gate.sh --offline: not re-run in this dossier context (see 'What was NOT re-verified' below).

verdict.summary: Phase 7 acceptance is green after GSL-297. All seven R7.x requirements DELIVERED with evidence — R7.4 now fully live-verified after GSL-303 shipped the tool-observed feeder + real Haiku pilot session populated current_tool + context_pct on /fleet. All six end-check bullets DELIVERED, EXCLUDED (soak-gated), or MOVED (skills-management), each with a direct link. Two real bugs uncovered and fixed inside the epic (GSL-298 snapshot.sh empty-pipe rc=1 leak; GSL-301 flushPendingObservations UPDATE-vs-INSERT branch selector — Bun `.get()` returns null, not undefined), both fenced with new core-smoke assertions. Softening from 'perfect 100' to 98 in acknowledgement of one bounded caveat: the tool-observed feeder covers only the tools `.claude/settings.json` matchers wire today (Bash, Write|Edit|MultiEdit, mcp__atlassian__.*, AskUserQuestion, PermissionRequest); Read/Grep/Glob/TodoWrite are not observed until settings.json widens — a separate owner-gated step (frozen per handoff 57). Widening interception to ALL sessions is the explicit next owner-gated step, documented in PRD + runbook section 8. An independent verifier should adjudicate the 6 pre-existing lab-smoke fails on the shared tree before the PR merges.

tasks_landed.title: [Web][Docs] Fleet live-values proof + flushPendingObservations bug fix

bugs_uncovered_and_fixed.bug: `prune_keep_last`'s empty-pipe case leaked exit 1 through `set -o pipefail` — every first snapshot on a fresh install returned rc=1 even though the .backup itself succeeded.
bugs_uncovered_and_fixed.fix: `|| true` on the while pipe + explicit `exit 0` at the tail, matching the header's 'Retention failures WARN and continue' contract.

bugs_uncovered_and_fixed.bug: Bun's `db.query(...).get(...)` returns `null` (NOT `undefined`) when no row matches — the branch selector `existing !== undefined` was true for a null result, so every fresh session_id took UPDATE not INSERT, UPDATE'd 0 rows, silently dropped the observation. First-time observations never landed in the DB.
bugs_uncovered_and_fixed.fix: `existing !== null && existing !== undefined` + removed the surrounding `db.raw.transaction(() => …)` wrapper (per-row atomicity is enough) + per-row try/catch that logs `core.tool_observed.flush_error` on failure. Regression fenced by core-smoke scenario 25b.

not_reverified: Run-02's 11 findings are treated as still-holding baselines (this dossier does not re-audit them; the fix-confirmation lens of run-02 is authoritative).

GSL-299 has BOTH shim-direct evidence (4 variants) AND one REAL subordinate haiku session leg (interactive tmux, GOSLEEP_WEB_QUESTIONS=1, --dangerously-skip-permissions). Attempted `claude --print --allowedTools AskUserQuestion` first — headless mode disables AskUserQuestion in the CLI regardless of --allowedTools, model refuses to call it; switched to interactive tmux (same shape GSL-267 used). GSL-300's PermissionRequest live-leg was NOT re-run against a real subordinate session — the shim-direct proof stands with GSL-284's smoke coverage (scenarios 42-50) as the anchor; the real-session equivalent would require a Bash/Write tool call that triggers PermissionRequest, which is orthogonal to the endpoint's contract.

The tool-observed shim (remaining gap above) was subsequently closed by GSL-303 (commit de06582): a pilot-gated feeder wired into three existing shims, .claude/settings.json untouched, live-proven on a real Haiku 4.5 pilot session (session_id 47f11f2a-…, /fleet returned current_tool=Bash + context_pct=8 + preserved current_intent).

Web UI visual verification (Safari / Chrome pixel rendering of the new 'Snapshot' button) was verified from source (Overview.tsx + tsc + vite build) rather than from a browser screenshot in this run — the button is a shadcn Button + Dialog composition already covered by design-system audits in run-02.
